questions.stem: A particle is moving in one dimension (along $x$ axis) under the action of a variable force. It's initial position was $16\,\mathrm{m}$ right of origin. The variation of its position (x) with time (t) is given as $x=-3 t^3+18 t^2+16 t$, where $x$ is in $m$ and $t$ is in $s$. The velocity of the particle when its acceleration becomes zero is_______ $\mathrm{m}/\mathrm{s}$.

Train A is moving along two parallel rail tracks towards north with speed $72 \text{km/h}$ and train B is moving towards south with speed $108 \text{km/h}$. Velocity of train B with respect to A and velocity of ground with respect to $B$ are (in $\text{ms}^{-1}$ ) :

A particle initially at rest starts moving from reference point. $x=0$ along $x$-axis, with velocity $v$ that varies as $v=4\sqrt{x}\,\text{m/s}$. The acceleration of the particle is____ $\text{ms}^{-2}$.

Position of an ant ( $S$ in metres) moving in $Y - Z$ plane is given by $S=2 t^{2}\hat{j}+5\hat{k}$ (where $t$ is in second). The magnitude and direction of velocity of the ant at $t=1\,\text{s}$ will be :

A particle starts from origin at $t=0$ with a velocity $5\hat{i} \text{m/s}$ and moves in $x-y$ plane under action of a force which produces a constant acceleration of $(3\hat{i}+2\hat{j}) \text{m/s}^2$. If the $x$-coordinate of the particle at that instant is $84 \text{m}$, then the speed of the particle at this time is $\sqrt{\alpha} \text{m/s}$. The value of $\alpha$ is____

A body falling under gravity covers two points A and $B$ separated by $80 \text{ m}$ in $2 \text{ s}$. The distance of upper point A from the starting point is____ $\text{m} (.$ use $\text{g}=10 \text{ms}^{-2})$
A body starts moving from rest with constant acceleration covers displacement $S_1$ in first ( $p-1$ ) seconds and $S_2$ in first $p$ seconds. The displacement $S_1+S_2$ will be made in time :

A ball rolls off the top of a stairway with horizontal velocity $u$. The steps are $0.1\ \text{m}$ high and $0.1\ \text{m}$ wide. The minimum velocity $u$ with which that ball just hits the step 5 of the stairway will be $\sqrt{x}\ \text{ms}^{-1}$ where $x=$________ [use $g=10\ \text{m}/\text{s}^2$ ].

A particle is moving in a straight line. The variation of position ' $x$ ' as a function of time ' $t$ ' is given as $x = (t^3 - 6t^2 + 20t + 15) \mathrm{m}$. The velocity of the body when its acceleration becomes zero is :

The displacement and the increase in the velocity of a moving particle in the time interval of $t$ to $(t+1) \text{ s}$ are $125 \text{ m}$ and $50 \text{ m/s}$, respectively. The distance travelled by the particle in $(t+2)^{\text{th}} \text{ s}$ is ____$\text{m}$.
The relation between time ' $t$ ' and distance ' $x$ ' is $t=$ $\alpha x^2+\beta x$, where $\alpha$ and $\beta$ are constants. The relation between acceleration (a) and velocity (v) is:

The co-ordinates of a particle moving in $x-y$ plane are given by :
$x=2+4 t, y=3 t+8 t^2 .$
The motion of the particle is :

options.label: B
options.content: uniformly accelerated having motion along a straight line.

options.label: C
options.content: uniform motion along a straight line.

options.label: D
options.content: uniformly accelerated having motion along a parabolic path.

questions.stem: A body travels $102.5\ \mathrm{m}$ in $n^{\text{th}}$ second and $115.0\ \mathrm{m}$ in $(n+2)^{\text{th}}$ second. The acceleration is :

A bus moving along a straight highway with speed of $72\,\text{km/h}$ is brought to halt within $4\,\text{s}$ after applying the brakes. The distance travelled by the bus during this time (Assume the retardation is uniform) is ________ $\text{m}$.

A body moves on a frictionless plane starting from rest. If $S_n$ is distance moved between $t=n-1$ and $t$ $= n$ and $S_{n-1}$ is distance moved between $t = n-2$ and $t=n-1$, then the ratio $\;\frac{S_{n-1}}{S_n}$ is $\left(1-\;\frac{2}{x}\right)$ for $n$ $=10$. The value of $x$ is _______
The maximum height reached by a projectile is $64\ \text{m}$. If the initial velocity is halved, the new maximum height of the projectile is ______ $\text{m}$.

A train starting from rest first accelerates uniformly up to a speed of $80 \mathrm{km/h}$ for time $t$, then it moves with a constant speed for time 3t. The average speed of the train for this duration of journey will be (in $\mathrm{km/h}$ ) :

A body projected vertically upwards with a certain speed from the top of a tower reaches the ground in $t_1$. If it is projected vertically downwards from the same point with the same speed, it reaches the ground in $t_2$. Time required to reach the ground, if it is dropped from the top of the tower, is :
A particle moves in a straight line so that its displacement $x$ at any time $t$ is given by $x^2=1+t^2$. Its acceleration at any time $t$ is $x^{-n}$ where $n=$ ______.

A body of mass $M$ thrown horizontally with velocity $v$ from the top of the tower of height $H$ touches the ground at a distance of $100 m$ from the foot of the tower. A body of mass $2 M$ thrown at a velocity $\frac{v}{2}$ from the top of the tower of height $4 H$ will touch the ground at a distance of ______ m.
The angle of projection for a projectile to have same horizontal range and maximum height is :

A particle moving in a straight line covers half the distance with speed $6 \text{ m/s}$. The other half is covered in two equal time intervals with speeds 9 $\text{ m/s}$ and $15 \text{ m/s}$ respectively. The average speed of the particle during the motion is :

Two cars are travelling towards each other at speed of $20 \text{ m} \text{ s}^{-1}$ each. When the cars are $300 \text{ m}$ apart, both the drivers apply brakes and the cars retard at the rate of $2 \text{ m} \text{ s}^{-2}$. The distance between them when they come to rest is :

A person travelling on a straight line moves with a uniform velocity $v_1$ for a distance $x$ and with a uniform velocity $v_2$ for the next $\frac{3}{2} x$ distance. The average velocity in this motion is $\frac{50}{7} \text{ m/s}$. If $v_1$ is $5 \text{ m/s}$ then $v_2=$ _____ $\text{ m/s}$.

A particle is projected at an angle of $30^{\circ}$ from horizontal at a speed of $60\,\text{m}/\text{s}$. The height traversed by the particle in the first second is $h_0$ and height traversed in the last second, before it reaches the maximum height, is $h_1$. The ratio $h_0: h_1$ is ______
[Take, $g=10\,\text{m}/\text{s}^2$ ]

A ball of mass 100 g is projected with velocity $20 \text{m} / \text{s}$ at $60^{\circ}$ with horizontal. The decrease in kinetic energy of the ball during the motion from point of projection to highest point is

The motion of an airplane is represented by velocity-time graph as shown below. The distance covered by airplane in the first 30.5 second is
______ km.

An object of mass ' $m$ ' is projected from origin in a vertical $x y$ plane at an angle $45^{\circ}$ with the $x$ - axis with an initial velocity $v_0$. The magnitude and direction of the angular momentum of the object with respect to origin, when it reaches at the maximum height, will be [ $g$ is acceleration due to gravity]
The position vector of a moving body at any instant of time is given as $\vec{r} = (5 t^2 \hat{i} - 5 t \hat{j}) \text{m}$. The magnitude and direction of velocity at $t = 2 \text{s}$ is,

options.label: A
options.content: $5 \sqrt{17} \text{m/s}$, making an angle of $\tan^{-1} 4$ with -ve Y axis

options.label: B
options.content: $5 \sqrt{17} \text{m/s}$, making an angle of $\tan^{-1} 4$ with +ve $X$ axis

options.label: C
options.content: $5 \sqrt{15} \text{m/s}$, making an angle of $\tan^{-1} 4$ with $+ \text{ve} X$ axis

options.label: D
options.content: $5 \sqrt{15} \text{m/s}$, making an angle of $\tan^{-1} 4$ with -ve $Y$ axis

questions.stem: The velocity a time graph of an object moving along a straight line is shown in figure. What is the distance covered by the object between $t=0$ to $t=$ $4\,\text{s}$ ?

The maximum speed of a boat in still water is $\frac{27\,\text{km}}{\text{h}}$. Now this boat is moving downstream in a river flowing at $\frac{9\,\text{km}}{\text{h}}$. A man in the boat throws a ball vertically upwards with speed of $\frac{10\,\text{m}}{\text{s}}$. Range of the ball as observed by an observer at rest on the river bank, is ______ $\text{cm} . ( .$ Take $g = \frac{10\,\text{m}}{\text{s}^2})$

Two projectiles are fired with same initial speed from same point on ground at angles of $(45^{\circ} - \alpha)$ and $(45^{\circ} + \alpha)$, respectively, with the horizontal direction. The ratio of their maximum heights attained is :

Two cars $P$ and $Q$ are moving on a road in the same direction. Acceleration of car $P$ increases linearly with time whereas car $Q$ moves with a constant acceleration. Both cars cross each other at time $t=$ 0 , for the first time. The maximum possible number of crossing(s) (including the crossing at $t=0$ ) is
______ .

A particle is projected with velocity $u$ so that its horizontal range is three times the maximum height attained by it. The horizontal range of the projectile is given as $\;\frac{n u^2}{25 g}$, where value of $n$ is :
(Given, ' $g$ ' is the acceleration due to gravity.)

A particle moves along the $x$-axis and has its displacement $x$ varying with time $t$ according to the equation:
$x=c_0 (t^2-2)+c(t-2)^2$ Where $c_0$ and $c$ are constants of apporopriate dimensions. Then, which of the following statements is correct?

options.label: A
options.content: The acceleration of the particle is $2c_0$

options.label: B
options.content: The initial velocity of the particle is $4c$

options.label: C
options.content: The acceleration of the particle is $2c$

options.label: D
options.content: The acceleration of the particle is $2(c+c_0)$

questions.stem:
The displacement $x$ versus time graph is shown below.
(A) The average velocity during 0 to 3 s is $10 \text{ m/s}$
(B) The average velocity during 3 to 5 s is $0 \text{ m/s}$
(C) The instantaneous velocity at $t=2 \text{ s}$ is $5 \text{ m/s}$
(D) The average velocity during 5 to 7 s and instantaneous velocity at $t=6.5 \text{ s}$ are equal
(E) The average velocity from $t=0$ to $t=9 \text{ s}$ is zero
Choose the correct answer from the options given below

Two projectiles are fired from ground with same initial speeds from same point at angles ( $45^{\circ}+\alpha$ ) and $(45^{\circ}-\alpha)$ with horizontal direction. The ratio of their times of flights is

A helicopter flying horizontally with a speed of 360 $\mathrm{km}/\mathrm{h}$ at an altitude of 2 km , drops an object at an instant. The object hits the ground at a point $\text{O},\ 20\ \mathrm{s}$ after it is dropped. Displacement of ' $\text{O}$ ' from the position of helicopter where the object was released is :
(use acceleration due to gravity $g=10\ \mathrm{m}/\mathrm{s}^2$ and neglect air resistance)

Two balls with same mass and initial velocity, are projected at different angles in such a way that maximum height reached by first ball is 8 times higher than that of the second ball. $T_1$ and $T_2$ are the total flying times of first and second ball, respectively, then the ratio of $T_1$ and $T_2$ is
The velocity of a particle is given as $\overset{\rightarrow}{v} = -x\hat{i} + 2y\hat{j} - z\hat{k} \text{m/s}.$ The magnitude of acceleration at point (1,2,4) is ________ $\text{m/s}^2.$

A river of width 200 m is flowing from west to east with a speed of $18\text{ km/h}$. A boat, moving with speed of $36\text{ km/h}$ in still water, is made to travel one-round trip (bank to bank of the river). Minimum time taken by the boat for this journey and also the displacement along the river bank are $\_\_\_\_$ and $\_\_\_\_$ respectively.

A projectile is thrown upward at an angle $60^{\circ}$ with the horizontal. The speed of the projectile is $20\text{ m/s}$ when its direction of motion is $45^{\circ}$ with the horizontal. The initial speed of the projectile is $\_\_\_\_$ $\text{m/s}$.

A paratrooper jumps from an aeroplane and opens a parachute after 2 s of free fall and starts deaccelerating with $3\ \mathrm{m/s}^2$. At 10 m height from ground, while descending with the help of parachute, the speed of paratrooper is $5\ \mathrm{m/s}$. The initial height of the airplane is $\_\_\_\_$ m.
$(g=10\ \mathrm{m/s}^2)$

A boy throws a ball into air at $45^{\circ}$ from the horizontal to land it on a roof of a building of height $H$. If the ball attains maximum height in 2 s and lands on the building in 3 s after launch, then value of $H$ is $\_\_\_\_$ m.
$\text{(g=10 m/s)}^2()$

Water drops fall from a tap on the floor, 5 m below, at regular intervals of time, the first drop strikes the floor when the sixth drop begins to fall. The height at which the fourth drop will be from ground, at the instant when the first drop strikes the ground is $\_\_\_\_$ m.
$(g=10\,\mathrm{m}/\mathrm{s}^2)$

A particle starts moving from time $t=0$ and its coordinate is given as $x(t)=4 t^3-3 t$ A. The particle returns to its original position (origin) 0.866 units later B. The particle is 1 unit away from origin at its turning point C. Acceleration of the particle is non-negative D. The particle is 0.5 units away from origin at its turning point E. Particle never turns back as acceleration is non-negative Choose the correct answer from the options given below :
The two projectiles are projected with the same initial velocities at the 15° and 30° with respect to the horizontal. The ratio of their ranges is 1 : x. The value of x is

A gun mounted on the ground fires bullets in all directions with same speed. The farthest distance the bullets could reach is 6.4 m. The speed of the bullets from the gun is ____ m/s. (take $g = 10\,\text{m/s}^2$)

If x and y coordinates of a projectile as a function of time (t) are given as 24t and $43.6t\, -\, 4.9t^2$, respectively, then the angle (in degrees) made by the projectile with horizontal when t = 2 s is ________.

Two cars A and B are moving in the same direction along a straight line with speeds 100 km/h and 80 km/h, respectively such that car A is moving ahead of car B. A person in car B throws a stone with a speed v so that it hits the car A with a speed of 5m/s. The value of v is ________ km/h.

At t = 0, a body of mass 100 g starts moving under the influence of a force $(5 \hat{i} + 10 \hat{j}) \,\mathrm{N}$ . After 2s its position is $(2x \hat{i} + 5y \hat{j}) \,\mathrm{m}$. The ratio $x:y$ is

From 18 m height above the ground a ball is dropped from rest. The height above the ground at which the magnitude of velocity equal to the magnitude of acceleration (in the same set of units) due to gravity is ___________ m.
(Take $g = 10\,\text{m/s}^2$ and neglect the air resistance)

The velocity(v) versus time (t) plot of a particle is shown in the figure, for a time interval of 40s. The total distance travelled by the particle and the average velocity during this period are, respectively _____

A gas balloon is going up with a constant velocity of 10 m/s. When this balloon reached a height of 75 m, a stone is dropped from it and balloon keeps moving up with the same velocity. The height of the balloon when the stone hits the ground is ______ m. (Take $g = 10\,\text{m/s}^2$)

Two identical bodies, projected with the same speed at two different angles cover the same horizontal range R. If the time of flight of these bodies are 5 s and 10 s, respectively, then the value of R is ________ m. (Take $g = 10\,\text{m/s}^2$)
